The reported `a27fa31…` checkpoint object and initial-stage originals are unavailable. Current/accepted package bytes and both required staged artifact hashes match; historical chronology remains unconfirmed, not reconstructed.
[Initial expectations](artifacts/attempt-evidence-expectations-0144.json) preceded #659 content; prior issue/0138-results exposure, the overly broad source excerpt and provider/model changes limit independence claims as recorded separately in the ledger.
Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; costs unavailable, `benchmark_ready=false`. Admission blocking establishes no trusted authority or real-admission algorithm.

Resume from the ledger and counterexamples; avoid replaying successful probes, closed grouping review, missing historical reconstruction, builders/evaluator, index promotion or readiness/owner requests. Review complete; no repair made.

No changes to merge.
